pacing_notes.c2_long_shots: 50% of c2 runtime is shots >7s: diagram/explainer 'build' shots where an element is added every ~1.5-2.5s, plus slide-in split panels the detector does not count
pacing_notes.cold_open_c1: 27 cuts in first 60s incl. a 0.3s-per-image flash montage (logo over 9 images in 2.5s); body 13-21 cuts/min

camera.notes: push-ins 1.04-1.21x over a shot (~1-6%/s) on emotional/close beats; pull-back reveals on build shots (chart -> monitor -> desk); small pans; most shots locked with character/text animation inside

transitions.slide_push_panels: common inside long shots (2-3 split panels slide in from the right)

text.dialogue: floating italic handwritten line above the speaker with a small tick toward them (most common); white rounded bubbles for emphatic lines; thought clouds; typed out fast

colour_notes: neutral greys (office walls, curved cyclorama corners), warm wood desks, teal/cyan glowing screens, navy data panels; red/green only for down/up; spotlight pools for drama; vignette light (corner/centre 0.88-0.96) vs war refs 0.6

structure.sponsor: one ~40-50s block at 4:40-6:40, screen recordings + coupon card + 'Okay, back to the video.' black card
structure.ending: quote card with portrait, then 'Subscribe' black card (~8s)
